import os, sys, json, math, time
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

Q = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0], dtype=float)

def interp_line(a, b, step=0.002):
    a=np.asarray(a,float); b=np.asarray(b,float)
    n=max(1,int(math.ceil(np.linalg.norm(b-a)/step)))
    return [a+(b-a)*i/n for i in range(1,n+1)]

def make_targets(points, step=0.002):
    out=[]
    for a,b in zip(points[:-1], points[1:]):
        out.extend(interp_line(a,b,step))
    return np.asarray([np.r_[p,Q] for p in out], dtype=np.float32)

def submit_path(r, points, note, cameras=('canvas_cam','practice_cam','side_cam'), video='both'):
    poses=make_targets(points)
    res=r.submit('ee_pose', poses, dt=0.05, cameras=cameras, video_fps=10, video=video, note=note)
    print(note, json.dumps(res.meta, default=str)[:5000])
    return res

def main():
    r=Robot()
    obs=r.get_obs(cameras=('canvas_cam','practice_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'),video='none')
    print('START', json.dumps({k:obs.meta.get(k) for k in ['step','control_steps','sim_time_s','time_left_s','proprio']},default=str))
    p=np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now'][7:10],float)
    # Ink stone dip; brush is loaded for the rest of the episode.
    pts=[p, [ -0.1,0.15,0.10],[-0.1,0.15,0.024],[-0.1,0.15,0.024],[-0.1,0.15,0.10]]
    # Three short strokes on practice sheet at increasing pressure, separated in x.
    # Each endpoint is lifted vertically before moving to the next line.
    for x,z in [(-0.135,0.019),(-0.170,0.016),(-0.205,0.012)]:
        pts += [[x,-0.145,0.10],[x,-0.145,z],[x,-0.225,z],[x,-0.225,0.10]]
    pts += [[-0.12,-0.18,0.10]]
    res=submit_path(r,pts,'ink dip then pressure calibration on practice sheet')
    res.save('/app/output/calibration')
    print('END',res.proprio[-1] if res.proprio is not None else None)
    print('STATUS',r.status())

if __name__=='__main__': main()

print('image threshold',im.min(),im.max(),'mask area',mask.sum(),'components',sorted(comps,reverse=True))
# Zhang-Suen thinning
s=mask.copy()
while True:
 removed=0
 for phase in [0,1]:
  p2=np.roll(s,1,0);p3=np.roll(np.roll(s,1,0),-1,1);p4=np.roll(s,-1,1);p5=np.roll(np.roll(s,-1,0),-1,1);p6=np.roll(s,-1,0);p7=np.roll(np.roll(s,-1,0),1,1);p8=np.roll(s,1,1);p9=np.roll(np.roll(s,1,0),1,1)

"""RoboPaint episode script for copying target.png with one loaded brush.

The practice calibration was already executed in this episode (three lines at
z=.019/.016/.012 m). Invoke --calibrate only in an episode where that has not
been done. The default action paints the 16-path plan on the scored sheet.
"""
import argparse, json, math, os
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
from scipy import ndimage as ndi
from rcb_client import Robot

TARGET = '/app/target.png'
OUT = '/app/output'
Q_DOWN = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0], dtype=float)
SHEET_Z = 0.020
PX_M = 0.227185 / 1024.0

# Each path names the graph nodes it follows. The paths jointly trace all of
# the exemplar's centerline branches; retraced junctions join them within the
# 16-stroke limit.
NODE_XY = {
 0:(508,421), 1:(708,358), 2:(692,572), 3:(432,427), 4:(342,373),
 5:(332,508), 6:(804,630), 7:(552,585), 8:(436,752), 9:(500,312),
 10:(556,518), 11:(569,209), 12:(324,753), 13:(342,641), 14:(226,467),
 15:(322,334), 16:(393,734), 17:(554,655), 18:(412,632), 19:(449.5,512.5),
 20:(704,637), 21:(717,264), 22:(346,576), 23:(395,219), 24:(692,443),
 25:(452,321), 26:(345,526), 27:(556,475), 28:(543,462), 29:(369,405),
 30:(675,437), 31:(588,271), 32:(437,765), 33:(687,512), 34:(404,571),
 35:(449,259), 36:(693,360),
}
ROUTES = [
 [23,35],                 # isolated upper dot
 [15,25,9],               # upper-left horizontal
 [25,3],                  # descending middle-left stroke
 [4,29],                  # detached left dot
 [14,3,0],                # long middle sweep
 [11,31,21],              # upper-right folded stroke
 [31,36,30,27,28],        # right-middle curved stroke
 [1,36,30,24],            # outer upper-right turn (shared junction)
 [5,26,22,13,12],         # lower-left vertical
 [22,34],                 # lower-left inner horizontal
 [13,18],                 # lower-left inner horizontal
 [26,19,8,16,8,32],       # lower-left top/right contour and terminal hook
 [27,10,7,17,6],           # lower-right vertical and broad terminal sweep
 [10,33],                 # lower-right horizontal
 [7,2],                   # lower-right horizontal
 [17,20],                 # lower-right horizontal
]


def thin(mask):
    """Zhang-Suen one-pixel skeleton."""
    s = mask.copy()
    while True:
        removed = 0
        for phase in (0, 1):
            p2=np.roll(s,1,0); p3=np.roll(np.roll(s,1,0),-1,1)
            p4=np.roll(s,-1,1); p5=np.roll(np.roll(s,-1,0),-1,1)
            p6=np.roll(s,-1,0); p7=np.roll(np.roll(s,-1,0),1,1)
            p8=np.roll(s,1,1); p9=np.roll(np.roll(s,1,0),1,1)
            nb=[p2,p3,p4,p5,p6,p7,p8,p9]
            count=sum(x.astype(np.uint8) for x in nb)
            seq=nb+[nb[0]]
            transitions=sum((~seq[i] & seq[i+1]).astype(np.uint8) for i in range(8))
            if phase == 0: cond=(~(p2&p4&p6)) & (~(p4&p6&p8))
            else: cond=(~(p2&p4&p8)) & (~(p2&p6&p8))
            rm=s & (count>=2) & (count<=6) & (transitions==1) & cond
            removed += int(rm.sum()); s[rm]=False
        if removed == 0: return s


def skeleton_graph(skel):
    """Collapse branch pixels and return node clusters plus centerline edges."""
    pts=[tuple(int(v) for v in p) for p in np.argwhere(skel)]
    present=set(pts); adj={p:[] for p in pts}
    for y,x in pts:
        for dy in (-1,0,1):
            for dx in (-1,0,1):
                if not (dy or dx): continue
                q=(y+dy,x+dx)
                if q not in present: continue
                # Avoid diagonal shortcuts where an orthogonal connection exists.
                if dy and dx and ((y+dy,x) in present or (y,x+dx) in present): continue
                adj[(y,x)].append(q)
    ends={p for p,neigh in adj.items() if len(neigh)!=2}
    clusters=[]
    while ends:
        seed=min(ends); ends.remove(seed); stack=[seed]; cluster=[]
        while stack:
            p=stack.pop(); cluster.append(p)
            for q in adj[p]:
                if q in ends: ends.remove(q); stack.append(q)
        clusters.append(cluster)
    clusters.sort(key=lambda cl:(np.mean([p[0] for p in cl]),np.mean([p[1] for p in cl])))
    cid={p:i for i,cl in enumerate(clusters) for p in cl}
    edges=[]; visited=set()
    for i,cluster in enumerate(clusters):
        for p in cluster:
            for q in adj[p]:
                if q in cid and cid[q]==i: continue
                key=tuple(sorted((p,q)))
                if key in visited: continue
                visited.add(key); path=[p]; prev=p; cur=q; path.append(cur)
                while cur not in cid:
                    choices=[v for v in adj[cur] if v!=prev]
                    if not choices: break
                    nxt=choices[0]; visited.add(tuple(sorted((cur,nxt))))
                    prev,cur=cur,nxt; path.append(cur)
                if cur in cid: edges.append((i,cid[cur],np.asarray(path,dtype=float)))
    return clusters, edges


def make_centerlines():
    grey=np.asarray(Image.open(TARGET).convert('L'))
    mask=grey<128
    dist=ndi.distance_transform_edt(mask)
    skel=thin(mask)
    clusters, edges=skeleton_graph(skel)
    node_ids={}
    means=[]
    for cl in clusters:
        means.append(np.array([np.mean([p[1] for p in cl]),np.mean([p[0] for p in cl])]))
    for key,xy in NODE_XY.items():
        d=np.linalg.norm(np.asarray(means)-np.asarray(xy),axis=1)
        ix=int(np.argmin(d))
        if d[ix]>2.0: raise RuntimeError(f'could not find graph node {key}: nearest error {d[ix]:.2f}px')
        node_ids[key]=ix
    edge_map={}
    for i,j,p in edges:
        k=frozenset((i,j))
        if k in edge_map: raise RuntimeError('unexpected parallel centerline edges')
        edge_map[k]=(i,j,p)
    centerlines=[]
    for route in ROUTES:
        parts=[]
        for a,b in zip(route[:-1],route[1:]):
            i,j=node_ids[a],node_ids[b]
            item=edge_map.get(frozenset((i,j)))
            if item is None: raise RuntimeError(f'missing graph edge {a}-{b}')
            ei,ej,path=item
            if (ei,ej)!=(i,j): path=path[::-1]
            if parts and np.linalg.norm(parts[-1][-1]-path[0])>0.01:
                parts.append(np.linspace(parts[-1][-1],path[0],max(2,int(np.linalg.norm(parts[-1][-1]-path[0]))+1))[1:])
            parts.append(path if not parts else path[1:])
        # A one-edge route is initialized above. Smooth each edge's pixel stair
        # steps lightly, while retaining its junctions and tapered endpoints.
        raw=np.concatenate(parts,axis=0)
        # Remove consecutive duplicate pixels before smoothing/resampling.
        keep=np.r_[True,np.linalg.norm(np.diff(raw,axis=0),axis=1)>1e-5]
        raw=raw[keep]
        if len(raw)>5:
            sm=np.column_stack([ndi.gaussian_filter1d(raw[:,0],1.5,mode='nearest'),
                                ndi.gaussian_filter1d(raw[:,1],1.5,mode='nearest')])
            sm[0]=raw[0]; sm[-1]=raw[-1]
        else: sm=raw
        delta=np.diff(sm,axis=0); seg=np.linalg.norm(delta,axis=1)
        arc=np.r_[0.0,np.cumsum(seg)]
        if arc[-1]<1.0: samples=sm.copy()
        else:
            d=np.r_[np.arange(0.0,arc[-1],6.2),arc[-1]]
            samples=np.column_stack([np.interp(d,arc,sm[:,0]),np.interp(d,arc,sm[:,1])])
        # Sample target half-width at each centerline point and invert the
        # practice-sheet depth/width calibration: width ~= 1.17*press_mm-.14.
        radius=ndi.map_coordinates(dist,[samples[:,0],samples[:,1]],order=1,mode='nearest')
        width_mm=2.0*radius*PX_M*1000.0
        press_mm=np.clip((width_mm+0.14)/1.17,0.45,12.0)
        z=SHEET_Z-press_mm/1000.0
        # target image row is +x/far; column maps toward -y.
        world_x=-0.100+0.1135925-(samples[:,0]+0.5)*PX_M
        world_y= 0.1135925-(samples[:,1]+0.5)*PX_M
        centerlines.append(np.column_stack([world_x,world_y,z,samples[:,1],samples[:,0]]))
    return centerlines, mask, dist


def preview(centerlines, mask):
    base=np.array(Image.open(TARGET).convert('RGB'))
    layer=Image.fromarray(base); draw=ImageDraw.Draw(layer)
    colors=['#ff3737','#2997ff','#37c76f','#f4b400','#b84cff','#ff6d00','#00aa9e','#ed4a9b']
    for i,path in enumerate(centerlines):
        xy=[(float(p[3]),float(p[4])) for p in path]
        draw.line(xy,fill=colors[i%len(colors)],width=3,joint='curve')
        for x,y in (xy[0],xy[-1]): draw.ellipse((x-3,y-3,x+3,y+3),fill=colors[i%len(colors)])
    layer.save(os.path.join(OUT,'planned_paths.png'))
    print('plan paths:',len(centerlines),'total samples:',sum(len(p) for p in centerlines))
    print('target area:',int(mask.sum()),'overlay:',os.path.join(OUT,'planned_paths.png'))


def calibration(r):
    """Executed earlier on the practice sheet; retained here for the record."""
    obs=r.get_obs(cameras=('canvas_cam','practice_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'),video='none')
    p=np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now'][7:10],float)
    pts=[p,[-.1,.15,.10],[-.1,.15,.024]]
    pts += [[-.1,.15,.024]]*10+[[-.1,.15,.10]]
    for x,z in [(-.135,.019),(-.170,.016),(-.205,.012)]:
        pts += [[x,-.145,.10],[x,-.145,z],[x,-.225,z],[x,-.225,.10]]
    pts += [[-.1,.15,.16]]
    rows=expand_points(pts)
    for start in range(0,len(rows),190):
        r.submit('ee_pose',rows[start:start+190],dt=.05,cameras=('practice_cam','side_cam'),video='none',note='practice pressure calibration')


def expand_points(points):
    rows=[]
    for a,b in zip(points[:-1],points[1:]):
        a=np.asarray(a,float); b=np.asarray(b,float); dist=np.linalg.norm(b-a)
        if max(a[2],b[2])<=SHEET_Z:
            step=.0014
        elif np.linalg.norm(b[:2]-a[:2])<1e-7:
            step=.0035
        else:
            step=.010
        n=max(1,int(math.ceil(dist/step)))
        for k in range(1,n+1): rows.append(a+(b-a)*k/n)
    return np.asarray([np.r_[p,Q_DOWN] for p in rows],dtype=np.float32)


def draw_episode(r, centerlines):
    obs=r.get_obs(cameras=('canvas_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'),video='none')
    now=np.asarray(obs.meta['proprio']['now'],float)
    points=[now[7:10].tolist()]
    high_z=.100
    for line in centerlines:
        first=line[0,:3]; last=line[-1,:3]
        points.append([float(first[0]),float(first[1]),high_z])
        points.append(first.tolist())
        points.extend(row[:3].tolist() for row in line[1:])
        points.append([float(last[0]),float(last[1]),high_z])
    # Park over the ink stone after the final lift, clearing the overhead view.
    points.append([-.100,.150,.160])
    rows=expand_points(points)
    print('planned control rows:',len(rows),'contact paths:',len(centerlines))
    records=[]
    for i in range(0,len(rows),190):
        res=r.submit('ee_pose',rows[i:i+190],dt=.05,
                     cameras=('canvas_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'),video='none',
                     note=f'龍 copy, planned chunk {i//190+1}')
        plan=res.meta.get('plan',[])
        fails=sum(int(p.get('ik_failures',0)) for p in plan)
        print('chunk',i//190+1,'rows',res.meta.get('executed_rows'),
              'IK failures',fails,'clipped',res.meta.get('n_clipped',0),
              'sim time',res.meta.get('sim_time_s'),'time left',res.meta.get('time_left_s'))
        res.save(os.path.join(OUT,f'draw_chunk_{i//190+1}'))
        records.append(res.meta)
    final=r.get_obs(cameras=('canvas_cam','practice_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'),video='none')
    for cam,img in final.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(img).save(os.path.join(OUT,f'final_{cam}.png'))
    with open(os.path.join(OUT,'episode_summary.json'),'w') as f:
        json.dump({'stroke_paths':len(centerlines),'planned_rows':len(rows),
                   'chunks':records,'final_meta':final.meta},f,indent=2)
    print('final status:',json.dumps(r.status()))


def main():
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('--plan-only',action='store_true')
    ap.add_argument('--calibrate',action='store_true')
    args=ap.parse_args()
    paths,mask,_=make_centerlines()
    if len(paths)!=16: raise RuntimeError(f'expected 16 paths, got {len(paths)}')
    preview(paths,mask)
    if args.plan_only: return
    robot=Robot()
    if args.calibrate: calibration(robot)
    draw_episode(robot,paths)

if __name__=='__main__': main()
